messages:
jamie: Quick check — late-stage optkit rollout status. We're aiming for canary tomorrow 9am PT. Need one-line owners for rollout, blockers, and whether quant recommendations are green. Who's owning canary and the rollout script?

noor: I'll own canary runs. Running benchmarks now, expect pass on p99 latency. Will post numbers by EOD. cc @samir for regression alerts.

samir: Saw a regression alert earlier on the image-embedding tests after the quant patch. I triaged: looks like kv-cache mismatch for seq_len >512. Filed issue #1423. Short-term mitigation: revert quant flag `enable_fast_q` in the canary image.

alex: Review ping for the CR — PR 892. Can reviewers pls prioritize? Main blockers are tests and docs. @priya any perf notes re: 4-bit quant for chat vs long-context?

priya: 4-bit quant looks fine for chat scenarios; for long-context requests we observed ~0.8% quality drop on Rouge. Suggest opt-in profile `quant_profile: conservative`. I'll add a small config snippet to the PR.

priya: ```
quant_profile: "conservative"
enable_fast_q: false
batching:
  max_batch_size: 16
  prefix_cache_kv: true
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary build queued: build/5521. CI: https://ci.redwood/build/5521 — status: queued -> running.

jamie: Thanks. @noor when you post numbers include p50/p95/p99 plus token/sec and cost delta. If the regression persists we hold the canary.

noor: Posted results in the run log: p50 32ms, p95 120ms, p99 310ms, token/sec +5%, cost -8%. Regression issue tracked in #1423. :thumbsup:

samir: I pushed a small kv-cache alignment fix, PR 895. If that lands we can keep `enable_fast_q` true for non-long-context workloads and gate it for long-context.

alex: I'm on review now. If we get approvals, can we gate the rollout by `canary=true` flag and enable 1-hour auto-rollback on error rate > 0.5%?

priya: Agree. I'll add the rollout policy to the console config and include the bench command: `./bench/run_canary.sh --profile conservative`.

jamie: Perfect. Owners clarified: canary -> noor, rollback/monitoring -> samir, CR reviews -> alex & priya. I'll close this thread after deploy completes. :rocket:
